prompts.applies_when: The firm offers statutory audit or identifies a public accountant
prompts.question: Has ACRA published a disciplinary order against the firm or an identified public accountant associated with it?
prompts.why_it_matters: A published disciplinary order may need attention or explanation.
prompts.how_to_query: Search named notices, open the order, confirm the same person or entity and the relationship and date.
prompts.found_when: A published order identifies the subject and specifies an action; report the exact order and date.
prompts.not_found_when: The accessible published list contains no confirmed match; this is not proof of a clean record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Page or order unavailable, identity or association uncertain, or source coverage incomplete.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: A named person claims to be an ACRA registered public accountant
prompts.question: Does the claimed public accountant have an active registration and the stated accounting entity in ACRA Bizfile?
prompts.why_it_matters: A misleading public accountant claim can affect confidence in statutory audit services.
prompts.manual_reason: Interactive Bizfile search and results require a form and cannot be fetched as a static list.
prompts.how_to_query: In Bizfile People search enter the person and 5-digit PA number; open More information and compare status and related entity.
prompts.found_when: The confirmed profile contradicts the current claimed registration or association.
prompts.not_found_when: The confirmed profile shows active status and the stated relationship.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Registration number is unavailable, profiles are ambiguous, or search cannot be completed.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: A named tax practitioner claims SCTP accreditation
prompts.question: Does the named professional claim the same SCTP tax accreditation and specialisation as the public member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Incorrectly described tax credentials can mislead prospective clients.
prompts.manual_reason: Directory search uses interactive fields and an alphabet selector; only consenting members are published.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the named professional and compare accreditation and specialisation; the directory only includes consenting members.
prompts.found_when: A confirmed directory entry explicitly conflicts with the specific claimed designation or specialisation.
prompts.not_found_when: The confirmed entry matches the stated current designation and specialisation.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Not listed, search unavailable, identity uncertain or membership not published by consent.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: A named individual claims CA (Singapore) or ISCA membership
prompts.question: Does the identified individual appear with the claimed designation in the ISCA member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A professional designation belongs to an individual and needs accurate attribution.
prompts.manual_reason: Interactive member search; directory allows members to opt out and may use verification.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the person and compare the claimed designation, confirming identity independently.
prompts.found_when: A confirmed public record expressly differs from the specific claim.
prompts.not_found_when: The confirmed record matches the claimed current status.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: No entry, opt-out, matching name is ambiguous, CAPTCHA or search unavailable.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.

prompts.applies_when: The firm claims to be an ISCA Singapore CA Qualification accredited training organisation
prompts.question: Does the firm match the ISCA accredited training organisation listing?
prompts.why_it_matters: Accurate training accreditation claims matter to prospective candidates.
prompts.manual_reason: Follow the linked ATO list and verify current access and entity coverage manually.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the linked ATO list and compare exact legal entity and any claimed tier; the list excludes subsidiaries and associates.
prompts.found_when: An explicit claim conflicts with confirmed official accreditation details for the same entity.
prompts.not_found_when: The current official listing confirms the same entity and the claim.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: List inaccessible, entity differs, listing coverage unclear, or entry absent without confirmation from ISCA.
prompts.not_applicable_when: The relevant service or claim is not present.
prompts.possible_match_when: The name matches but identity or entity relationship is not independently established.
